findings: Group header renders round(group.similarity*100) percent similar. Detector supplies configured threshold rather than measured group minimum/average, so this displayed number is not an observed group similarity.

Each row marks an item Keep only if present in caller-provided keptSet; selected other members are labelled Trash. Row does not independently enforce at least one valid kept member. Caller last-kept guard was previously reviewed.
Group labels distinguish photos/videos via truthy duration; mixed groups are labelled items, acknowledging poster/still matches. No video-content confirmation here.
List adds thirty groups at a time with IntersectionObserver; this is incremental mounting, not row recycling. Per-group thumbnails all mount; no runtime performance measurement.

Viewer stores a group object/index and filters missing media records when constructing items. Missing entries before the selected raw index can shift preview index; group object is not refreshed when groups change. Viewer implementation still needs review before asserting rendered outcome.

useBlobUrl suppresses post-cleanup asynchronous state updates and revokes object URL, but does not clear blobUrl on URL changes, undefined URL, or failed fetch. Returned state can retain a previous/revoked object URL.
ThumbnailImage displays Skeleton whenever blobUrl absent and ignores loading/error state. Failed fetch can leave indefinite skeleton. Requests have no abort or timeout in this hook.
